A1.justification: Both complete 17-page PDFs describe the same work. Text, equations, figures, and Appendices A–B are accessible; pages 2–17 have identical text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: Section 6 and Appendix B report original exploration and policy-pretraining experiments on secret-room and two-agent Reacher environments, including results in Figures 2–5.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical results in Section 6 and Appendix B, including exploration, sparse-reward learning, and zero-shot evaluation.

M1.justification: The joint, disjoint, and mixture objectives and the TRPE procedure in Section 5 and Algorithm 1 are unchanged, including importance sampling and decentralized trust-region updates.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same secret-room and two-agent Reacher domains for exploration and sparse-reward policy-pretraining evaluations. No task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain the same objective variants, uniform/random-initialization controls, and MA-TRPO pretraining comparisons in Figures 2–5.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendix B retain identical discretization, exploration horizons, policy configurations, training budgets, reward settings, and evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The state-visitation comparisons, exploration-horizon analyses, and policy-entropy diagnostics in Figures 2, 4, and 5 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report averages and 95% confidence intervals over four runs in Figures 2–3. Appendix B retains the same four-seed disclosure; no statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The plotted entropy and return results, uncertainty bands, and qualitative findings in Section 6 and Figures 2–5 are identical. No result entries are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, entropy and objective-mismatch bounds, convergence arguments, and policy-class proofs in the main text and Appendix A are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about Convex Markov Games, the characterization of exploration objectives, TRPE, and the practical benefits of mixture objectives.

C2.justification: The explanations involving clustering, coordinated exploration, and disjoint-objective overfitting are unchanged, as are qualifications concerning high-dimensional entropy estimation and centralized-policy guarantees.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains identical environment specifications, network architectures, initialization details, and hyperparameters. The embedded repository hyperlink also points to exactly the same address.

R1.justification: Section 7, the references, and research-positioning statements are unchanged, including the discussion of concurrent work on Convex Markov Games.

P1.justification: v2 adds 'Preprint.' on the first page and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The substantive prose, terminology, section order, and appendix structure are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: The first page gains a small 'Preprint.' footer and an updated marginal arXiv stamp. Figures 1–5 and all remaining page layouts are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The only changes are the first-page preprint label and version/date stamp. The scientific text, results, figures, proofs, appendices, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, so these administrative edits produce no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
